proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature family
proposed_widenings.justification: Primal Champion grants a permanent ability-score increase at level-up with no activation, no resource, no reset cadence, and no use count. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which mandates activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect. Forcing those fields onto this feature would fabricate mechanics the SRD text does not describe.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
proposed_widenings.justification: The sole mechanical content of Primal Champion is a permanent +4 to STR and CON with a hard cap of 25. No existing ClassFeatureEffect covers this: grant_extra_action and heal_hp are both wrong. The v4 taxonomy lists 'modify_ability_score as a runtime effect' as a deferred residue item (section 12), explicitly flagged out-of-scope. This unit provides a direct pressure case for promoting it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

notes: Primal Champion is a purely passive permanent ability-score boost granted at level 20. It requires no action, consumes no resource, and has no reset cadence. The ClassFeatureMechanics surface has only one family ('activation'), which cannot honestly represent a passive permanent feature. Additionally, the needed effect atom (modify_ability_score) is absent from both the surface types and the v4 atom inventory. No dhall or json authored — fabricating activation mechanics would produce a false trace.
